results.content:
Trump’s approval stood at only 37 percent in a new survey from YouGov and The Economist released this week. Sixty-one percent disapproved of his job performance. It surveyed 1,469 registered voters from September 4 to 8, 2026.

In a Morning Consult poll, his approval was a net of -11, with 54 percent disapproving and 43 percent approving of the president’s job performance. The poll was conducted among 2,201 registered voters from September 4 to 6, according to The New York Times.

That's an improvement for Trump from the week before, when 35% approved and 61% disapproved for a net approval of -26.
